title: Do Neural Models Prefer Their Submodels?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28439v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A neural model is the set of functions that can be expressed by a given neural network architecture. Neural models contain natural submodels, such as those obtained by setting some neurons to be inactive. We study the geometry of neural models and ask whether they prefer their submodels. By this we mean whether local minimizers of the loss function lie in a given submodel. We introduce a geometric framework to determine if this occurs. For shallow multilayer perceptrons, we show that subnetworks with inactive hidden neurons are never preferred. For deep multilayer perceptrons, we give conditions under which subnetworks with inactive hidden neurons are not preferred. For lightning self-attention, lower-rank submodels are usually not preferred, but we identify examples where they are because they lie on a boundary of the model. Our results show that, aside from a few exceptions, preference for submodels cannot be explained by the geometry

translated_title: 神经模型是否偏好其子模型？
translated_abstract: 神经模型是指由给定神经网络架构所能表达的函数集合。神经模型包含天然的子模型，例如通过将某些神经元设为不活跃状态而得到的子模型。我们研究神经模型的几何结构，并探究它们是否偏好其子模型，即损失函数的局部极小值点是否位于给定的子模型中。我们引入了一个几何框架来判断这种情况是否发生。对于浅层多层感知机，我们证明了含有不活跃隐藏神经元的子网络永远不会被偏好。对于深层多层感知机，我们给出了含有不活跃隐藏神经元的子网络不被偏好的条件。对于闪电自注意力机制，低秩子模型通常不被偏好，但我们也发现了一些例外情况，即低秩子模型因位于模型边界上而被偏好。我们的结果表明，除少数例外情况外，对子模型的偏好无法用几何结构来解释。
tldr: 该论文通过引入几何框架研究神经模型的几何结构，证明除少数模型边界上的例外情况外，损失函数的局部极小值点通常不会落在由不活跃神经元或低秩结构构成的子模型中。
en_tdlr: By introducing a geometric framework, this paper shows that, aside from a few exceptions where submodels lie on model boundaries, local minimizers of the loss function generally do not prefer submodels formed by inactive neurons or lower-rank structures in neural networks.
